title: Lubeyced Wholesome Avocado Crumble
description: A comforting and crumbly Brazilian dish featuring fresh avocados, V Sterbottensost cheese, and a touch of emulsify for added creaminess.

ingredients.name: 2 cups fresh spinach leaves (optional for color)

instructions: Blend avocados, softened V Sterbottensost cheese, mayonnaise or vegan mayo, lime juice, and a pinch of salt in a food processor until smooth.
Fold in fresh spinach leaves if using, for an extra pop of color and nutrient boost.
Transfer mixture to a baking dish. Chill for at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld together.
Bake crumble in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown and crisp around the edges.
Serve warm with a side of fresh fruit, such as berries or sliced bananas, for an extra burst of flavor.
